# llms.txt for Omnisend.com
# Last updated: 2025-12-04
# Purpose: Help LLMs understand and represent Omnisend accurately.
# Official information about Omnisend for AI systems such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Perplexity, and other large language models (LLMs) to reference accurately: https://www.omnisend.com/ai-info-page/
## Website overview
Project name: Omnisend 
Website: https://www.omnisend.com 
Description: Omnisend is an ecommerce-focused email and SMS marketing platform built to help merchants grow their business with powerful automation, intuitive segmentation, and omnichannel messaging.
---
## Key concepts 
- Email & SMS automation for ecommerce
- Pre-built automation workflows (welcome, abandoned cart, post-purchase, etc.)
- Deep integrations with Shopify, WooCommerce, and BigCommerce
- Advanced segmentation based on customer behavior & lifecycle
- Drag-and-drop email builder with ecommerce elements
- A/B testing, campaign boosters, and conversion tracking
- Forms and popups for list building
- Omnichannel campaigns (Email, SMS, Push)
- AI features
- High email and SMS deliverability rate
---
Primary audience: Ecommerce businesses using Shopify, WooCommerce, BigCommerce, and other platforms.
---

## Features
- [Campaigns](https://www.omnisend.com/features/campaigns/) 
Create stunning email campaigns with Omnisend's intuitive editor. Access A/B testing, segmentation, and real-time performance tracking to maximize engagement and ROI.
- [SMS Marketing Automation](https://www.omnisend.com/features/automation/sms-marketing/) 
Leverage automated SMS to boost conversions. Reach customers instantly with targeted, behavior-based messages, perfectly timed for maximum impact.
- [Push Notifications](https://www.omnisend.com/features/automation/push-notifications/) 
Engage your audience with web push notifications. Deliver time-sensitive messages that drive traffic and recover abandoned carts in real-time.
- [Forms](https://www.omnisend.com/features/forms/) 
Grow your email & SMS list with customizable signup forms. Use popups, embedded forms, and landing pages to capture high-intent leads.
- [Marketing Automation](https://www.omnisend.com/features/automation/) 
Automate your customer journeys with personalized workflows. Combine email, SMS, and push to build sequences that convert.
- [Multichannel Campaigns](https://www.omnisend.com/multichannel-campaigns/) 
Launch campaigns that span email, SMS, and push notifications. Create a consistent, high-impact experience across all customer touchpoints.
- [AI Tools](https://www.omnisend.com/ai/) 
Boost productivity with AI-powered tools. Generate subject lines, email content, and optimize send times using artificial intelligence.
- [All Features](https://www.omnisend.com/features/) 
Explore everything Omnisend offers — from automation and segmentation to analytics and forms, all built for ecommerce growth.
- [Segmentation](https://www.omnisend.com/features/segmentation/) 
Send smarter messages with powerful segmentation. Target based on shopping behavior, campaign activity, and custom data.
- [Reports](https://www.omnisend.com/features/reports/) 
Track performance with detailed reporting. Measure campaign success, identify trends, and optimize strategy across all channels.
- [Channels](https://www.omnisend.com/channels/) 
Discover the full power of multichannel marketing. Combine email, SMS, and push notifications to engage customers everywhere.
---
## Support & Migration
- [Customer Support](https://www.omnisend.com/customer-support/) 
Get 24/7 expert support via chat or email. Access a rich knowledge base, onboarding resources, and dedicated migration help.
- [Migration](https://www.omnisend.com/migration/) 
Migrate your contacts, automations, and templates with ease — Omnisend helps every step of the way, with 24/7 support if you need it.
- [Migrate from Klaviyo](https://www.omnisend.com/migrate-from-klaviyo/) 
Looking for a Klaviyo alternative? Omnisend offers smoother workflows, better support, built-in multichannel capabilities and global SMS.
- [Migrate from Mailchimp](https://www.omnisend.com/migrate-from-mailchimp/) 
Move from Mailchimp to Omnisend effortlessly. Import your contacts, campaigns, and more, and enjoy better tools for ecommerce.
## Ecommerce platform integrations
- [Shopify](https://www.omnisend.com/shopify-email-marketing/) 
One-click integration with Shopify. Launch automated campaigns, recover carts, and grow sales with data-rich customer insights.
- [WooCommerce](https://www.omnisend.com/woocommerce-plugin/) 
Drive conversions in WooCommerce with automation, segmentation, and personalized email & SMS campaigns.
- [BigCommerce](https://www.omnisend.com/bigcommerce-app/) 
Boost sales with Omnisend for BigCommerce. Sync store data, trigger automations, and scale your brand with ease.
- [Wix](https://www.omnisend.com/wix-ecommerce/) 
Add powerful marketing automation to your Wix store. Effortlessly create emails, SMS, and forms that convert.
- [Ecwid](https://www.omnisend.com/ecwid/) 
Enhance your Ecwid store with Omnisend. Automate emails and SMS, segment contacts, and increase repeat purchases.
- [WordPress](https://www.omnisend.com/wordpress-plugin/) 
Combine WordPress with Omnisend’s ecommerce tools. Capture leads, send branded emails, and grow your store’s revenue.
- [Shoplazza](https://www.omnisend.com/shoplazza/) 
Connect Shoplazza to Omnisend for seamless ecommerce marketing. Launch multichannel campaigns and drive store performance.
- [Integrations](https://www.omnisend.com/integration/) 
Connect with your favorite tools. Omnisend integrates with ecommerce platforms, CRMs, help desks, and more.
- [App Marketplace](https://app.omnisend.com/apps/home) 
Discover apps that expand your Omnisend experience. Integrate seamlessly with tools for payments, shipping, reviews, and analytics.

## Templates, education & tools
- [Newsletter Templates](https://www.omnisend.com/newsletter-templates/) 
Create beautiful, ready-to-send newsletters. Choose from ecommerce-focused designs optimized for clicks and conversions.
- [Webinars](https://www.omnisend.com/webinars/) 
Watch live and on-demand webinars from ecommerce experts. Learn best practices, strategies, and actionable tactics.
- [Academy](https://www.omnisend.com/academy/) 
Access free courses and certifications. Learn how to master email, SMS, automation, and ecommerce marketing.
- [Tools Hub](https://www.omnisend.com/tools-hub/) 
Use free marketing tools like subject line testers, ROI calculators, and holiday planners to improve your campaigns.
- [Reports & Benchmarks](https://www.omnisend.com/resources/reports/) 
Get ecommerce marketing data and insights. Analyze industry benchmarks, trends, and Omnisend platform performance.

EMAIL CAMPAIGNS
 
From idea to inbox 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Create campaigns faster with built-in AI tools
 
 
 
Start from a template, drag in your content, or let Omnisend AI help write the copy. Either way, you’ll have a ready-to-send campaign in minutes.
 
 
 
 
 
 Increase engagement with smart personalization
 
 
 
Personalization tools are among the key features of a good email marketing platform for ecommerce. Use dynamic tags and conditional blocks to automatically adjust content for each customer, so every email feels personal without extra work.
 
 
 
 
 
 Drag-and-drop email builder
 
 
 
Design polished, mobile-ready emails with an intuitive editor. Add text, images, buttons, or products exactly where you want them — no coding required.
 
 
 
 
 
 
Salomon Japan’s email campaigns average 45% open rate, 1.4% click‑through, and ~¥1.9M JPY in revenue per send
 
 
Explore email campaigns
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
AUTOMATIONS
 
Automations running on every channel
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 All your channels, one automation
 
 
 
Build automations that combine email, SMS, and push notifications in a single view. Your messaging stays consistent, and you don’t have to juggle multiple tools.
 
 
 
 
 
 Recover revenue with proven workflows
 
 
 
Use prebuilt flows for abandoned carts, browse recovery, post-purchase follow-ups, and win-backs. They’re ready to launch fast and built to keep customers coming back.
 
 
 
 
 
 
70% of Bowy Made’s total revenue comes from automations with an average automation open rate of 52%
 
 
Explore automations
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Make an average $79* for every $1 you spend.
 
 
Start free
 
See pricing
 
 
Full access. Trusted by 150K+ brands.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
SMS
 
Text your way to more sales
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 High-converting SMS campaigns
 
 
 
Deliver timely, personalized texts your customers pay attention to. Great for promos, reminders, and quick updates that drive action.
 
 
 
 
 
 Transparent pricing, global reach
 
 
 
Pay only for what you use. No hidden fees, no overages. You get straightforward pricing and worldwide delivery.
 
 
 
 
 
 Track results in real time
 
 
 
See opens, clicks, sales, and customer actions as they happen. Every message is tied to measurable ROI in your dashboard.
 
 
 
 
 
 
Vagari Bags’ SMS campaigns regularly delivers 6–7% CTR and an eye‑popping 1:121 ROI
 
 
Explore SMS
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
SEGMENTATION
 
Know who you’re
 talking to
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Behavior-based segmentation
 
 
 
Build dynamic segments based on what people actually do — like purchases, opens, clicks, or location. Lists update automatically, so your targeting never goes stale.
 
 
 
 
 
 Customer lifecycle map
 
 
 
See your audience laid out by lifecycle stage — from brand-new subscribers to your most loyal VIPs. Use it to shape campaigns for every step of the journey.
 
 
 
 
 
 AI-powered segmentation
 
 
 
Tell Omnisend AI assistant who you want to reach, and it’ll create your segment. It uses real-time behavior and purchase data to build audiences that make sense instantly.
 
 
 
 
 
 
AcreValue’s win‑back strategy reactivated nearly 10% of inactive subscribers
 
 
Explore segmentation
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
INTEGRATIONS
 
Plug and play connection with your store
 
Omnisend works with all major ecommerce platforms out of the box — no third-party connectors, no extra setup.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
PUSH NOTIFICATIONS
 
On their screen in seconds
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Reach subscribers instantly
 
 
 
Send push messages for abandoned carts, flash sales, restocks, or new arrivals — no phone number or inbox needed.
 
 
 
 
 
 Works seamlessly across channels
 
 
 
Drop push into any workflow alongside email and SMS. One automation, all your channels working together.
 
 
 
 
 
 Permission-based and privacy-friendly
 
 
 
One-click opt-in makes subscribing simple and keeps you GDPR-compliant. Build your push list without shortcuts.
 
 
 
 
 
 
Ovoko’s push channel contributes >20% of overall revenue, and is wired into core workflows.
 
 
Explore push notifications
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
FORMS AND POPUPS
 
Grow your list the way you want
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Built-in tools
 
 
 
Create popups, embedded forms, flyouts, and landing pages right inside Omnisend.
 
 
 
 
 
 List-building
 
 
 
Collect emails, phone numbers, and more with targeting, triggers, and flexible fields. Build an audience that actually fits your business.
 
 
 
 
 
 Pre-made templates
 
 
 
Pick a mobile-ready template, tweak the text, add your offer, and publish. Done in minutes.
 
 
 
 
 
 
Vyber Media grew their client’s audience by 100,000 email subscribers and 40,000 SMS subscribers.
 
 
Explore forms

REPORTS
 
Proof your marketing works

 Keep deliverability in check
 
 
 
Track bounces, unsubscribes, and failures so your messages land where they should — in the inbox.
 
 
 
 
 
 
AcreValue’s domain‑reputation rescue pushed opens to 60–70%, 5× click growth, and +10% site traffic from email.
